overview_description.description: Fortify is an advanced manufacturing startup that aims to disrupt additive manufacturing, ushering in a new generation of custom, high-performance products. Fortify has developed a patented process that combines 3D printing and magnetics to create aligned reinforced carbon fiber composites. Magnetics and DLP (digital light processing) are used in Fortify's technology to create bespoke microstructures in high-resolution 3D printed composite products. Engineers can create and print items with optimum material qualities for specific purpose. The application focus of the company varies from injection mold tooling to high-performance end-of-life parts.

product.name: Digital Composite Manufacturing (DCM) Platform
product.description: A 3D printing technology that integrates fiber reinforcement into photopolymers to produce composite parts with controlled microstructures and enhanced mechanical properties.

product.name: FLUX CORE 3D Printer
product.description: A DLP-based 3D printer designed to process highly viscous, particle-filled resins for manufacturing advanced composite parts without fiber alignment capabilities.

product.name: FLUX ONE 3D Printer
product.description: A DLP 3D printer that combines fiber alignment and CKM technology to produce composite parts with isotropic properties along the z-axis for enhanced mechanical performance.

product.name: Flux Developer Platform
product.description: A software and consulting service platform that supports material development and process optimization for Fortify's FLUX Series 3D printers.

product.name: High Temperature and Strength (HTS) Resin
product.description: A ceramic fiber-filled photopolymer resin designed for 3D printing parts with high heat deflection temperature and tensile strength for tooling and end-use applications.
